text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick thread for speaker-coach + mic-check checklist for Friday's webinar 'Serving LLMs: Ops & Economics'. Need 1) three-minute speaker coaching doc, 2) mic-check checklist, 3) emergency 60s fallback script, and 4) confirmed rehearsal order.

Liam (Events): Green room opens 25m prior. Rehearsal slots: Thu 11:00 or Fri 09:00. Which do speakers prefer?

Noah (Product): Fri 09:00 for me. Also want a short note in the coaching doc: avoid saying specific dollar figures unless we have the final benchmarks.

Zoe (Design): I'll make a one-pager coach PDF with speaker do/don't bullets and a 2-slide teaser for socials. Need headshots + 1-line bios.

Hannah (Sales): For CTAs, recommend: 1) schedule 15m office hours, 2) download benchmark one-pager, 3) request a POC. We'll track who clicks which.

Victor (Eng): Mic-check checklist: please run these steps before you go live:
```
- confirm headset mic selected in OS
- mute system notifications
- run quick echo test: 10s speak -> listen
- close unused apps (esp. video)
- verify push-to-talk mapping if used
```
I'll drop this to the speaker doc.

Ava (Marketing): Love it. For the coaching doc, I'll include: 1) 3-min opener script template, 2) how to hit the benchmark narrative in 90s, 3) phrasing to avoid overclaiming, 4) Q&A handoff language.

Noah (Product): Opener template please include a 1-sentence value statement + 1 quick customer hook. Keeps it tight.

Zoe (Design): I'll export the coach PDF + a social 15s caption card. Also create a small slide with exact timestamps for the fallback clip.

Liam (Events): Rehearsal order confirmed: Host intro -> Product -> Eng demo -> Customer -> Panel Q&A. We'll reserve 40m for the run-through. Invites sent.

Ava (Marketing): Emergency 60s fallback script (for host):
"We hit a live demo snag, switching to a brief recorded clip which walks through the same flow. We'll publish full logs and a follow-up deep-dive. If you'd like a tailored architecture review, book a 15-minute slot now."

Hannah (Sales): Note: include a calendar link param with UTM tag in fallback CTAs so SDRs can see who converted from the contingency messaging.

Victor (Eng): Also adding a tiny network checklist for the demo runner: wired ethernet, ethernet-only on laptop, disable VPNs, set system to high-performance.

Ava (Marketing): Owners summary: Coach doc + fallback script = Ava; Mic & network checklists = Victor; Rehearsal scheduling = Liam; Assets + PDF = Zoe; CTAs + booking flow = Hannah. Rehearsal Fri 09:00. Closing thread. :raised_hands:

audio-bot: Reminder scheduled: mic-check ping to speakers 30m before event.
